competing_explanation: The 40% figure could arise from an unvalidated or confounded assay, but no such record exists in this source; the only relevant validated study shows 15%.
hypothesis_statement: VERDICT: FALSE, because the in-house Phase I crossover study (A1) reports a geometric mean ratio of 1.15 (90% CI 1.08-1.22), i.e. ~15% bioavailability increase, and its 90% CI explicitly excludes the 1.40 ratio required by the claim.
predicted_outcome: The true RX-441/reference AUC ratio is approximately 1.15 with a 90% CI of 1.08-1.22, not 1.40.
refutation_criterion: A properly powered, validated bioavailability study showing a geometric mean ratio of 1.40 with a 90% CI that includes or exceeds 1.40 would falsify this verdict.
